title: A Confederacy of Dunces
author: John Kennedy Toole
summary: Ignatius J. Reilly, a pompous, unemployed medievalist living with his mother in New Orleans, is forced to find work. His schemes collide with a cast of eccentric locals.
readIf: you like broad, absurd comedy with an unforgettable, unbearable hero.
skipIf: you have little patience for self-absorbed characters or rambling plots.
